LanguageData.SmokeleafHigh.label: stoned on hemp
LanguageData.SmokeleafHigh.description: Hemp's active chemical in the bloodstream. Generates a soft feeling of fuzzy well-being.
LanguageData.SmokeleafTolerance.label: hemp tolerance
LanguageData.SmokeleafTolerance.description: A built-up tolerance to hemp. The more severe this tolerance is, the more hemp it takes to get the same effect.
LanguageData.SmokeleafAddiction.label: hemp dependence
LanguageData.SmokeleafAddiction.description: A chemical addiction to hemp. Long-term use of hemp has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug.\n\nWithout regular doses of hemp, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.
